acquired.scope: Five existing installed RPC scenarios extend their completed native generated-compaction journey with the real installed public Core forkSession API, independent Core-manager child reload and one installed PATH-bin child conversation.
acquired.copies: Complete canonical model input is equal after child reload, including private signatures, provenance and retained compaction context. Fork creation checks parent/branch links; child reload checks parent and compaction metadata. This is a fork, not an independent-root clone.
acquired.replay: Explicit same-provider/model CLI selection lowers the entire retained native assistant arrays exactly, with original operator labels/canonical API/requested-model identities and native Azure deployment-body distinction. One new signed child reply persists with exact provider/API/model provenance.
acquired.durability: Original source bytes stay unchanged immediately after fork creation and after child execution. Immutable copied child entries stay unchanged while child metadata/leaf may advance. Both journals retain 0600 protection and exclude the disposable credential; private carrier bytes do not leak in live RPC records.
acquired.scenarioCounts: 15 installed cases and prior deadlines/assertions/effect controls remain; five native fork operations add five CLI processes/SSE requests per full run. Source/assertion-derived totals: 79 requests (76 SSE/three JSON), 40 processes, 15 effects; not separately printed counters.

limits: Installed Core SDK fork plus CLI child replay, not execution of the RPC fork command or browser/HTTP fork actions.
Five named original native paths only; no every-profile/dialect, complete abandonment/error/withdrawal/fork-variant or whole MOD-03 certificate.

Source raw history is conserved; this does not claim that every abandoned/pre-compaction source entry is duplicated into the child. Canonical child equality and immutable copied-entry retention are the tested contracts.

Synthetic loopback continuation is structural evidence, not vendor signature authenticity, service/account access or secure erasure. Same-provider/model is explicitly reselected, not automatically restored.
No new product, public API/schema, dependency/compiler/build/runner/case-count/deadline/retry policy, mitigation, diagnostic expansion, native-exit retry, gate waiver or QUA-01 reopening.

Bedrock signed carrier HOLD remains pending its explicit contract answer; goal continuation is not that answer. Prior generated-compaction source/failures and the resolved Docker construction disposition remain unchanged.
Named image readbacks and frozen tracked-source equality are not every environment/context byte. No fresh pinned SDK reference execution or upstream JSON/cryptographic proof.
